source: The preset for fluent-vue. It reads Fluent .ftl files, <fluent> blocks in Vue files, and $t and $ta calls.
text: Il preset per fluent-vue. Legge i file Fluent .ftl, i blocchi <fluent> nei file Vue e le chiamate a $t e $ta.
